checkedOccurrences.fixedText: The border went up to Debir from the valley of Achor, and so northward, looking toward Gilgal, that faces the ascent of Adummim, which is on the south side of the river. The border passed along to the waters of En Shemesh, and ended at En Rogel.
It extended northward, went out at En Shemesh, and went out to Geliloth, which is opposite the ascent of Adummim. It went down to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben.

wikipediaActualRead.identityBasisJa: 記事はJoshua 15:7と18:17のascentとして同定しつつ、地理的位置は不明確とも記す。現代のTal’at ed-Dummとの同定を確定事項として採らない。

geographyAssessment: 坂道・経路の候補として既存点を表示可能。ただし単一点は道路の代表位置にすぎず、境界線や現代道路の確定線と誤解させないラベルが必要。
